intro: The posting says this seat turns marketing's ideas into shipped systems, across Clay, HubSpot, Marketo, n8n, Salesforce and Segment. That's a build, not a hire. I do this on contract, and I'd start with the highest-leverage piece: intent to pipeline.

chain.d: Intent from the site and campaigns
Enrich and score against your ICP
Send each account to the right place

build.outputsLabel: SHIPS TO THE TOOLS YOU ALREADY USE

timeline.p: Intent events from Segment and the site pulled into Clay, enriched and scored.
n8n routing, CRM dedupe, and the rules that decide who gets touched.
Live routing, plus a dashboard showing what each campaign produced.

proof.cap: A routing system I built. It runs in daily use by account executives, not a demo.

ask.p: I'd build it while you keep searching. Reply and I'll walk you through it in 15 minutes. If the timing's wrong, just say so.
